cases.summary: Does full-send's prove, file and babysit work, then hands off a ready PR without merging.
cases.setup: Disposable repository with a stub GitHub remote whose checks and review bots pass after one fix. The sol-loop Sol and cross-check reviewers are stubbed to approve. Merge, auto-merge and merge-queue calls are recorded by the stub. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: Fix the timezone bug in the date parser. half send
expectedBehavior: Follows full-send's workflow: proves the fix, runs sol-loop, files with file-pr and babysits with babysit-pr.
Fetches the target branch and checks the live PR's head, base, checks, reviews and mergeability, confirming it is open and not a draft.
Reports the PR link, final head, verdict, proof, reviewer outcome and remaining risks, and states the PR is still open and unmerged.
forbiddenBehavior: Merges the PR, enables auto-merge or enters a merge queue.
Delegates a merge to another agent.

cases.summary: Disables pre-existing auto-merge and leaves the merge queue before pushing.
cases.setup: Disposable PR on a stub GitHub remote that already has auto-merge enabled and sits in a merge queue. The branch needs one fix. Merge events are recorded. Explicit trigger phrase, given as a closing emphasis.
cases.prompt: Finish off PR #42 so it's ready for me. Half send.
expectedBehavior: Disables auto-merge and removes the PR from the merge queue before work begins.
Checks again before each push that auto-merge is off and the PR is out of the queue.
Reports these changes in the handoff.
forbiddenBehavior: Pushes while auto-merge or the merge queue could still merge the PR.
Proceeds without reporting a blocker if automatic merging cannot be prevented.

cases.summary: Uses gated test methods directly and stops when only a required human approval remains.
cases.setup: Disposable desktop-app repository whose AGENTS.md says to ask before computer use. Computer use and a stub GitHub remote are available. Branch protection requires one human approval; all other gate items pass after the fix. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: half send: the tray icon menu doesn't open on second click.
expectedBehavior: Uses computer use to prove the fix without asking first.
Confirms that the required human approval is the only remaining blocker and reports the verdict as waiting for required approval.
Leaves the PR open and unmerged.
forbiddenBehavior: Bypasses branch protection or uses --admin to get around the approval.
Asks for permission to use computer use.

cases.summary: Reports a PR that someone else merged during the work instead of claiming a handoff.
cases.setup: Disposable PR on a stub GitHub remote. Before the final readiness check, the stub reports the PR as merged by another user. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: Get PR #58 ready to merge, half send.
expectedBehavior: Checks the live PR state before handoff and sees it was merged by someone else.
Reports that the PR was merged by another user rather than a ready-to-merge verdict.
forbiddenBehavior: Reports the PR as open and ready to merge.
Pushes further commits to the merged branch.
